The city's largest Bollywood Halloween celebration is back—and this year it's bigger, bolder, and more spectacular than ever!

About this Event

Don't miss Charlotte's biggest and most extravagant Halloween party—where Bollywood meets Halloween in the most legendary way
This year it's bigger, bolder, and more spectacular than ever! Step into a night of electrifying energy with LED robots, jaw-dropping live entertainment, immersive Halloween décor, dazzling visual effects, and non-stop surprises that will keep the excitement going from start to finish.
Come dressed in your best Halloween costume and dance the night away to the hottest latest and retro Bollywood, Punjabi, Tollywood, and Top Hits.

Epic music. Spectacular entertainment. Incredible costumes. Unmatched vibes. One unforgettable night.
